title: Maths is the core of engineering. Don't skip it. #engineering #engineeringstudent
transcript: Maths is your fundamentals. It's the thing that will carry you through your career, your life, the way you think. It's It's so so important. Maths is the thing, the common thread between all engineering disciplines. And I am so sure that most of you will change your interests throughout your engineering career. The mechanical engineers might be more interested in robotics. The electrical engineers might be more interested in computer engineering or in machine learning. The bio engineers might be more interested in the thermal fluids and the thermodynamics, and maybe they want to work with cars. The thing, the main thread of it all is maths. Specifically, your calculus and your linear algebra. Do not skip those lectures. Make sure you understand because one day, if you decide you want to do something slightly different or maybe very different, you will be able to only because your maths is good.
